description: A stroke layer takes erasers and light: an eraser stroke and glowing strokes stay editable, and the layer's pixels and light are redrawn from them.

error.message: The Smudge brush moves the paint under it, so it can't be redrawn on its own; rasterize the layer first (rasterize_stroke_layer) or blend on a pixel layer.
Layer "Glow" is a stroke layer. The Watercolour round brush paints wet media, which a stroke layer can't redraw (the paint depends on the simulation's history); paint it on a pixel layer (add_layer).
